name: Northwestern University
summary: Private research university in Evanston, on Lake Michigan just north of Chicago. Economics is one of Weinberg College's most popular majors, and more than half of its students double major.

scholarships.eligibility: Admission is need-aware for international students; each year a small group of first-year international students receives need-based aid.
scholarships.coverage: 100% of demonstrated need over the full cost of attendance, as grants — no loans or work
